name: Motivational Quote
description: Single-quote centerpiece format — one powerful quote owns the entire video. Minimal visuals, maximum impact. Best for inspirational, mindset, and quotable share-bait content.
voice_style: deep, resonant, deliberate — each word lands with weight; confident pauses before and after the quote; slight reverb for gravitas
music_mood: cinematic orchestral, emotional piano, ambient swell — quiet build, peak at quote climax, gentle fade

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: This is the quote that changed how I work. Listen carefully.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person staring into middle distance, moody dramatic lighting, slight fog in background, contemplative expression, camera slowly pushing in
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow cinematic push-in from medium to close-up, hold on contemplative expression
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: single dramatic key light from above-right, deep shadows on face, soft fog in background, moody cinematic aesthetic
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Moody cinematic lighting is non-negotiable for quote format; fog/haze in background adds cinematic depth

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Text appearing word by word on screen, cinematic nature b-roll (light streaming through window), person closing eyes listening to own words, quote marks appearing at sides of frame, soft focus background
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static close-up on person delivering, b-roll overlay fades in/out, slow push-in on final 'don't settle'
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm cinematic key light, nature b-roll: golden light rays through window in fog, high-key soft tones, cinematic bokeh
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Word-by-word text reveal with nature b-roll is the proven quote format; final 'don't settle' deserves a slow push-in for emphasis

scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Portrait photo of Steve Jobs appearing subtle in corner, text attribution in clean sans-serif font, background still cinematic
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static hold, subtle fade-in of attribution element
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: same warm cinematic tones, attribution text in clean white, portrait photo slightly desaturated
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Attribution should be subtle and clean — the quote owns the moment, not the source

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Save this. Share it with someone who needs to hear it today. And follow for more.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person smiling at camera, share icon and heart icons floating up, follow button highlighted, warm golden light returning
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow return to medium close-up, warm direct address, gentle energy
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm golden light returning, brighter and warmer than quote delivery, inviting and warm
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Lighting warmth shift signals emotional landing — from contemplative to connected; share/heart icons add shareability
